verdict.rationale: Probes show no llms.txt and no markdown doc variants (both 404). YYLO does publish first-party Skills, which are agent-steering, versioned procedures for operating YYLO and Ledger and installable via an open standard. That is a thin form of agent-oriented documentation. missing for 10: llms.txt, markdown/agent-readable doc pages, evidence that Skills cover the full documentation surface, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: YYLO Skills are independently versioned, reusable procedures for operating YYLO and Ledger.
A skill can steer an agent and may reference executable procedures.
The direct open-standard path is available now and can install the repository or one slug.
